programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Lorsque Lucy, trentenaire, réalise qu'elle n'a jamais été attirée par les hommes, Jane, son amie de toujours, l'aide à dévoiler son homosexualité.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Une enseignante respectée dans un collège privé voit sa vie chamboulée par l'arrivée d'une nouvelle élève, qui est la fille qu'elle a donnée en adoption il y a 17 ans.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Après avoir fait face à des problèmes de dépendance, une adolescente pense enfin pouvoir tourner la page en intégrant une nouvelle école.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Après que Link découvre que sa mère Mi'kmaw est toujours en vie, lui et son jeune frère, Travis, se lancent dans un voyage pour la retrouver et commencer une nouvelle vie.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: De retour dans sa ville natale pour Noël, une médecin a l'opportunité de reprendre la pratique de son père, parti à la retraite, et de poursuivre sa vie avec son amour de jeunesse.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Une pâtissière qui rêve d'ouvrir son propre commerce est associée à un autre chef pour un grand événement: les deux doivent s'unir pour créer un menu à temps pour Noël.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: À Londres, en 1938, une comédienne de théâtre complote un plan élaboré pour se venger d'un ambitieux sans scrupules qui l'a manipulée.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Lillian est une femme d'affaires qui aide les petites entreprises. Elle tombe soudainement sous le charme de Grant, le fondateur de la nouvelle entreprise avec qui elle fait affaire.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: De connivence avec son ami Louis, Sarah feint d'être en détresse en bordure d'une autoroute pour voler ceux qui lui viennent en aide. Sous les yeux de l'adolescente, un homme meurt. Sa vie ne sera plus jamais la même.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Une solide amitié lie Gabe et Karen et Beth et Tom, deux couples qui se connaissent depuis une douzaine d'années. Un soir, Beth annonce que Tom la quitte pour une autre femme.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: 1976, Canada. Elizabeth, fille unique de 11 ans, découvre que sa mère et son père ne sont pas ses parents biologiques. Déboussolée, elle se réconforte en écoutant les chansons de Dolly Parton, qui passent constamment à la radio et à la télévision.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Une femme fuyant son ex-petit ami trouve refuge dans une ferme isolée, sans savoir que quelque chose de bien pire l'attend à l'intérieur.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Sara et sa fille de 18 ans trouvent leur maison de rêve dans un magnifique quartier, mais découvrent que l'ancien propriétaire de la maison refuse de lâcher prise.

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.title: Cinéma

programme.desc: A man and an old high school friend try to sell his uncle's business -- a Mexican bakery that's famous for magical gingerbread cookies that grant wishes.

programme.title: Hearts of Christmas
programme.desc: When a beloved neonatal intensive care unit supervisor is forced to take early retirement, her young colleague, Jenny, decides to turn the staff Christmas party into a surprise bash for her, but the plan is complicated by the hospital's new CFO.

programme.title: Season's Greetings From Cherry Lane
programme.desc: In 1951, a wartime doctor tries to make Christmas special for his worried wife. In 2003, a newly married couple host two sets of in-laws for Christmas Eve. In 2024, a couple try to arrange special holiday surprises for each other.

programme.title: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: The future son-in-law (Sean O'Bryan) of a prominent Cabot Cove family is suspected in the shooting of a hardware store employee.

programme.title: A December Bride
programme.desc: Layla accompanies Seth to her cousin's wedding, and everyone is surprised when she announces they're engaged. They are forced to keep up the pretense, and as they spend more time together, they find themselves feeling something very real.

programme.title: Romance at Reindeer Lodge
programme.desc: Molly and Jared have both sworn off holiday events. When they find themselves stuck at a Christmas-themed ranch, they have no choice but to allow their cynical hearts to melt.

programme.title: Christmas at Pemberley Manor
programme.desc: A rich man falls back in love with Christmas and a party planner.

programme.title: Christmas She Wrote
programme.desc: When a writer has her column canceled right before Christmas, she heads home to reconnect with her family, only to receive an unexpected visit from the man who canceled her column.

programme.title: A Bramble House Christmas
programme.desc: While settling his father's estate, a man becomes suspicious as to why the man left his nurse a large sum of money after knowing her for less than two months before he died.

programme.title: The Christmas Quest
programme.desc: An archeologist and her ex-husband, an expert in ancient Norse languages, are sent to Iceland at Christmastime to search for the treasure of the Yule Lads.

programme.title: Christmas Scavenger Hunt
programme.desc: When Belinda heads to her hometown for the holidays, things get complicated when she is forced to team up with her ex-boyfriend Dustin for the town's annual Christmas scavenger hunt.

programme.title: November Christmas
programme.desc: A community works together to help a couple bring an early Christmas to their sick 8-year-old daughter (Emily Alyn Lind).

programme.title: Love at the Thanksgiving Day Parade
programme.desc: A woman (Autumn Reeser) falls for a consultant (Antonio Cupo) who helps her coordinate a Thanksgiving parade.

programme.title: Christmas in My Heart
programme.desc: Violinist Beth returns home after the recent death of her mother and tutors the daughter of a reclusive country music star to prepare her for the upcoming holiday concert.

programme.title: The Christmas Shepherd
programme.desc: Sally is heartbroken when her dog runs away during a thunderstorm. When she learns he was found by Mark, a widower, she travels to Boston to get him. Sally and Mark are given the best Christmas gifts of their lives when they fall in love.

programme.title: Joyeux Noel
programme.desc: When a romantic painting of a Christmas market captures the imagination of copy editor Lea, she travels to France with a pragmatic reporter to uncover the mystery behind the artist.

programme.title: Looks Like Christmas
programme.desc: An over-involved single mother (Anne Heche) butts heads with a single dad (Dylan Neal) over the school's annual Christmas Spectacular, an event that she feels like she owns.

programme.title: Holly & Ivy
programme.desc: A contractor helps a woman renovate a house so she can adopt a sick neighbor's two children.

programme.title: A Gingerbread Romance
programme.desc: An architect begins to find herself longing for a place to call her own as she works alongside a baker to win a gingerbread house contest.

programme.title: A Rose for Christmas
programme.desc: When a talented artist has no choice but to take the helm of her father's float-building business, she's forced to deal with a demanding businessman who doesn't have patience for art.

programme.title: Cherished Memories: A Gift to Remember 2
programme.desc: As Darcy and Aiden prepare to celebrate their second Christmas together, an unexpected guest and a fight to save the beloved community center unites everyone for an unforgettable holiday.

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's Maggie's Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: Maggie tries to maintain the balance of being a mother and having a career. When her son Jordan needs help at school, he meets Casey, a tutor, and the two quickly bond. As Casey becomes a father figure, Jordan wishes his mom could find love again.

programme.title: Five Gold Rings
programme.desc: An artist returns home for the holidays and gets tasked with a Christmas quest left by her grandmother. She and the local PI must return lost items to their owners before Christmas.

programme.title: The Royal Nanny
programme.desc: Working undercover as a nanny, an MI5 agent must resist the charms of Prince Colin while keeping the royal family safe during Christmastime.

programme.title: Christmas Connection
programme.desc: Sydney is tasked with looking after Leah, an unaccompanied minor. After Leah is safely delivered, Sydney finds a package Leah left behind and decides to deliver it. When she misses her connection, she is invited to spend the holidays with them.

programme.title: A Nashville Christmas Carol
programme.desc: A workaholic television producer receives a visit from her recently deceased mentor, who warns her that her current path leads to a dark future.

programme.title: Navigating Christmas
programme.desc: Recently divorced Melanie and her son Jason visit a remote island for Christmas, only to find themselves running a real working lighthouse where she connects with the curt but cute owner.

programme.title: Christmas Wonderland
programme.desc: Heidi returns home to watch her niece and nephew and comes face to face with her high school love. Heidi offers to help him with a dance, and the more time she spends decorating, the more she finds herself inspired to start painting again.

programme.title: I'm Not Ready for Christmas
programme.desc: Holly's world is turned upside down when her niece's wish to Santa Claus comes true, and she cannot tell a lie. As her career and love life go into disarray, she must learn to judge between the truth and what is right.

programme.title: #Xmas
programme.desc: When interior designer Jen is selected for a social media competition for a design brand, she poses as an influencer with her best friend playing her husband and her nephew as her baby.

programme.title: Christmas at Holly Lodge
programme.desc: Sophie Bennett, the owner of the Holly Lodge, tries to convince a developer that the lodge is actually a bad investment.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas Crush
programme.desc: Ava accepts the opportunity of a lifetime to work at the Royal Ice Hotel, which leads to a surprise whirlwind romance with the most important guest of all, the prince himself.

programme.title: Reunited at Christmas
programme.desc: As a child, Samantha spent every Christmas at her beloved Nana's house building the traditions of fun and joy with her family. Sam is facing the first Christmas without Nana and still struggling to find the Christmas spirit when she gets a surprise.

programme.title: Two Turtle Doves
programme.desc: Dr. Sharon Hayes returns home to search for a beloved family heirloom. With the help of an adorable little girl and her dispirited father, together they rediscover the magic of Christmas.

programme.title: Return to Christmas Creek
programme.desc: After being told her new holiday app lacked Christmas spirit, a young CEO returns to her hometown to rediscover the meaning of the holidays.

programme.title: Christmas in Evergreen
programme.desc: Hoping to spur her longtime beau to action, a small-town veterinarian wishes upon a snow globe that this will be her most romantic Christmas ever.

programme.title: Sealed With a List
programme.desc: This holiday season, festive Carley sets out to conquer her list of abandoned resolutions from last year. Aided by co-worker Wyatt, she finds love and the confidence to chase her dreams.

programme.title: Home for Christmas Day
programme.desc: A young woman begins a long-distance relationship with an active-duty soldier. Her mother tries to steer her away from the relationship to save her feelings.

programme.title: Unwrapping Christmas: Tina's Miracle
programme.desc: Successful gift-wrapping shop owner Tina is in charge of planning this year's annual Christmas gala. But things begin to go awry when the gala faces cancellation due to a scrooge-like estate owner.

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Ash Williams, the lone survivor of an earlier onslaught of flesh-possessing spirits, holes up in a cabin with a group of strangers while the demons continue their attack.

programme.title: Evil Dead
programme.desc: At a remote forest cabin, five friends discover a Book of the Dead and unwittingly summon an ancient demon. The malevolent entity possesses each person in succession, until only one is left intact to fight for survival.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: A reunion between two estranged sisters gets cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

programme.title: Evil Dead Burn
programme.desc: After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 1
programme.desc: After their car breaks down in an eerie small town, a young couple is forced to spend the night in a remote cabin. Panic ensues as they are terrorized by three masked strangers who strike with no mercy and seemingly no motive.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
programme.desc: After learning that their victim, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya finds herself in a fight for survival against psychopaths who'll kill anyone who stands in their way.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Parapsychologist Elise Rainier and her team travel to Five Keys, N.M., to investigate a claim of a haunting in her childhood home. She must soon confront and destroy her greatest fear, the demon that she accidentally set free years earlier.

programme.title: Insidious: The Red Door
programme.desc: Josh Lambert heads east to drop his son, Dalton, off at school. However, Dalton's college dream soon becomes a living nightmare when the repressed demons of his past suddenly return to haunt them both.

programme.title: Final Destination 3
programme.desc: A high-school senior (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) and her friends must deal with repercussions of cheating death when they survive a terrible roller-coaster accident.

programme.title: Final Destination 5
programme.desc: When a man's premonition saves them from a fatal bridge collapse, several unfortunate souls learn that Death will not be cheated.

programme.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
programme.desc: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

programme.title: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story

programme.title: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: Detectives make great strides in Dorothy's case and an unlikely witness emerges with a vexing admission.

programme.title: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: Although Dorothy's murder gets solved, what was unearthed in her case is a trail of murders, mobsters, and a horrific history that still haunts this community.

programme.desc: Nikki Glaser takes on a range of topics in her brutally honest yet conversational style, including dishing about sex, outlining the dos and don'ts of dating, how to trick someone into marriage and oversharing about her not-so-private parts.

programme.desc: The comic brings her unique blend of honesty and unapologetic sense of humor to a performance at the historic Apollo Theater in New York.

programme.title: The Invite
programme.desc: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When their upstairs neighbors visit for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

programme.title: Thanksgiving
programme.desc: A mysterious masked maniac terrorizes residents of Plymouth, Mass., one year after a Black Friday riot ended in tragedy. Picking off victims one by one, the seemingly random revenge killings soon become part of a larger, sinister plan.

programme.title: ParaNorman
programme.desc: A ghoul-whispering youngster (Kodi Smit-McPhee) battles zombies, ghosts, witches and ignorant adults to save his town from an ancient curse.

programme.title: Blumhouse's Truth or Dare
programme.desc: A game of truth or dare results in fatalities when an unknown entity penalizes participants for lying or declining challenges.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Survivors (Woody Harrelson, Jesse Eisenberg, Emma Stone) of a zombie apocalypse use creative means to dispatch the undead as they make their way toward a rumored safe haven in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Post-apocalyptic warriors Tallahassee, Columbus, Wichita and Little Rock must rely on their wits and weapons more than ever as they find themselves in a relentless battle against smarter, faster and seemingly indestructible zombies.

programme.title: Dust Bunny
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Aurora asks a hit man to kill the monster she believes ate her entire family. To protect her, he'll need to battle an onslaught of assassins while accepting the fact that some monsters are real.

programme.title: Death of a Unicorn
programme.desc: A weekend retreat has deadly consequences when a father and daughter accidentally hit and kill a unicorn while en route to find his billionaire boss, who seeks to exploit the creature's miraculous curative properties.

programme.title: Marty Supreme
programme.desc: Marty Mauser, a wily hustler with a dream no one respects, goes to hell and back in pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: An Intimate Evening With Adam Pally
programme.desc: Equal parts stand-up, documentary and rock concert, Adam Pally plays with the truth and his guitar in a one-time-only performance.

programme.title: Deadpool 2
programme.desc: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool must protect a teenage mutant from Cable -- a genetically enhanced soldier from the future. He soon joins forces with Bedlam, Shatterstar, Domino and other mutants to battle Cable and his powerful advanced weaponry.

programme.title: They Will Kill You
programme.desc: A woman answers a cryptic ad for a housekeeping job at a luxurious yet foreboding New York City high-rise. Upon arrival, she discovers residents have vanished without a trace for decades, fueling whispers of a satanic cult lurking in the shadows.

programme.title: Ian Lara: Romantic Comedy
programme.desc: New York comedian Ian Lara explores the lessons learned during the pandemic and more.

programme.title: Pillion

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: A high school student exploring her independence on homecoming night is disrupted by her older brother and the shadows of their past.

programme.title: Saltburn
programme.desc: A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer.

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

programme.title: Barbie
programme.desc: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Reluctant to dance, the son of Mumble (Elijah Wood) the tap-dancing penguin runs away from home and meets a penguin that can fly.

programme.title: The Royal Tenenbaums
programme.desc: An errant father (Gene Hackman) tries to reconcile with his eccentric and underachieving family (Anjelica Huston, Ben Stiller) in New York.

programme.title: Crazy Rich Asians
programme.desc: Rachel Chu is happy to accompany her longtime boyfriend, Nick, to his best friend's wedding in Singapore. She's also surprised to learn that Nick's family is extremely wealthy, and he's considered one of the country's most eligible bachelors.

programme.title: Norm of the North

programme.desc: À la marge des vrais maquisards luttant contre l'occupant, de "faux maquis" se constituèrent.

programme.title: Coupable non coupable
programme.desc: Le 8 novembre 1999, le corps de Brigitte Muller, 42 ans, est retrouvé sans vie dans le sous-sol du domicile conjugal, tuée d'une balle dans la tête, l'arme à feu de son mari à ses pieds.

programme.title: Chefs d'oeuvre d'Edgar Degas
programme.desc: Inclassable parmi les impressionnistes, Edgar Degas porte un regard aussi précis qu'audacieux sur la vie moderne.

programme.title: 1940-1944: le cinéma de mon ennemi
programme.desc: À travers des productions de l'époque, les traces de la mémoire populaire et les récits des historiens, ce film explore le paradoxe d'un engouement pour le cinéma nazi dans des régions annexées par l'Allemagne, pourtant hostiles à l'occupant.

programme.title: Sexe et amour au Brésil
programme.desc: Au Brésil, la séduction est un art de vivre; ici, la drague est directe, les femmes prennent l'initiative et les relations sans lendemain sont monnaie courante; dans les soirées électriques de Rio, on flirte sans tabou, porté par le culte du corps.

programme.title: Lamarck, le savant et le visionnaire
programme.desc: Né en 1744, Jean-Baptiste Pierre Antoine Monnet de Lamarck était passionné par la science de la vie.

programme.title: Jour d'audience
programme.desc: Marina Boulanger accuse son ex-petit ami, Anthony Mercier, d'avoir mis à son insu des images intimes d'elle sur Internet. Anthony nie les accusations, car, dit-il, son téléphone avait été volé.

programme.title: Glaciers - Enquête sur une disparition
programme.desc: Effondrement des glaciers, débordement des lacs glaciaires, élévation du niveau des mers, déstabilisation des courants océaniques.

programme.title: Habiter le monde
programme.desc: Dans le village de Pongin, en Inde, Philippe va à la rencontre des Adi, une ethnie d'environ 100 000 personnes disséminées dans la région himalayenne.

programme.title: L'assassinat d'Henri IV
programme.desc: Le 14 mai 1610, Henri IV rend visite à son ministre Sully, malade. Arrivé rue de la Ferronnerie à Paris, le convoi est bloqué. François Ravaillac profite de cet incident pour s'approcher du carrosse et frapper le roi de plusieurs coups de couteau.

programme.title: Loup, où es-tu?
programme.desc: Le loup est-il de retour dans les Hauts-de-France ? Dans ce documentaire exceptionnel, nous partons sur les traces de l'animal mythique disparu depuis plusieurs siècles dans les forêts de la région.

programme.title: Le poney de Connemara, une légende irlandaise
programme.desc: Les habitants du Connemara sont fiers que leur région soit le berceau d'une race de cheval réputée pour son endurance et sa gentillesse : le poney du Connemara.

programme.title: Les sanctuaires de la nature
programme.desc: Territoire lointain de l'Extrême-Orient, le Japon est une terre singulière et fantasmée, aux paysages d'une grande beauté, semblables aux estampes des grands maîtres japonais.

programme.title: La fabuleuse histoire de l'argent
programme.desc: L'argent a bouleversé le cours des civilisations. En Chine, tout commence dans les tombes de hauts personnages, il y a environ cinq mille ans? On y dépose des cauris que l'on retrouve aujourd'hui par milliers.

programme.title: Les sanctuaires de la nature
programme.desc: Territoire lointain de l'Extrême-Orient, le Japon est une terre singulière et fantasmée, aux paysages d'une grande beauté, semblables aux estampes des grands maîtres japonais.

programme.title: Coupable non coupable
programme.desc: En juin 2009, le procès de Jean-Paul Gournier, 50 ans, chirurgien spécialisé en maladies cardiovasculaires, s'est tenu devant la cour d'assises du Rhône. Il était accusé d'avoir tué ses parents en les empoisonnant.

programme.title: Jour d'audience
programme.desc: Sofia Esria, ancienne mannequin cheveux, accuse Sarah Perrière, directrice d'une école de coiffure, d'avoir gravement endommagé ses cheveux lors d'une coloration avant un défilé.

programme.title: Les îles Kerguelen : aux confins du monde
programme.desc: Kerguelen, Crozet, Tromelin, ces îles françaises du bout du monde suscitent rêveries et fantasmes.

programme.title: Capital
programme.desc: Chaque été, les îles de l'Atlantique sont prises d'assaut par cinq millions de vacanciers.

programme.title: Loup, où es-tu?
programme.desc: Le loup est-il de retour dans les Hauts-de-France ? Dans ce documentaire exceptionnel, nous partons sur les traces de l'animal mythique disparu depuis plusieurs siècles dans les forêts de la région.

programme.title: Western: colts, torgnolles et haricots
programme.desc: Le mythe du cowboy est né dans les studios américains, mais quand on dit western, un nom revient sans cesse : celui de Sergio Leone, grand architecte du western dit spaghetti, car produit en Italie. Ce genre a permis l'émergence de nouveaux talents.

programme.title: Nazcas, les lignes qui parlaient au ciel
programme.desc: Dans le sud du Pérou, au pied de la cordillère des Andes, des vestiges fabuleux d'une ancienne civilisation défient le temps; les Nazcas y ont bâti des cités, tracé un immense réseau de lignes géométriques et d'incroyables géoglyphes.

programme.title: Quand l'histoire fait dates
programme.desc: La banqueroute du système financier imaginé par l'Écossais John Law pour liquider la dette colossale laissée par le règne de Louis XIV est le premier grand krach de l'histoire européenne.

programme.title: (in)fidèles
programme.desc: Où commence l'infidélité? Quelles sont ses limites? Est-on vraiment infidèle si l'on embrasse quelqu'un d'autre?

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Le 31 juillet 1914, Jean Jaurès, pacifiste convaincu, fervent opposant à la guerre, leader incontesté de la gauche et défenseur des ouvriers, est assassiné. Sa mort intervient trois jours avant l'entrée de la France dans la Première Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: Les dernières girafes
programme.desc: Afrique de l'Est, 2040 ; les réserves dans lesquelles vivaient autrefois les animaux ont réduit de moitié ; les agriculteurs ont gagné du terrain et empiètent désormais largement sur les territoires sauvages.

programme.title: Tuamotu sauvages
programme.desc: N'émergeant que de quelques mètres de l'eau, Rangiroa est un anneau de corail posé sur le bleu de l'océan ; son profond lagon, protégé par une immense barrière corallienne, est le deuxième plus vaste de la planète et regorge de vie.

programme.title: Habiter le monde

programme.title: Louis XIV et l'affaire des poisons
